motions.item_title: Recommend approval to the City Council of 7. A. Athletic Facility Signs, with two recommendatio…
motions.motion: Commissioner Hess moved to recommend approval to the City Council of 7. A. Athletic Facility Signs, with two recommendations. First, under the definition 17.80.160 to include: a sign attached to a fence surrounding and immediately adjacent to an athletic facility can be facing the interior or exterior of the athletic facility. Second, 17.80.120(R) to include: all signs must be attached to the fence, scoreboard, or bleachers and may not extend above the fence, scoreboard, or bleachers. Commissioner Allen seconded the motion, with the changes noted.
motions.headline: New sign rules for athletic fields
motions.summary: The commission recommended sign rules for athletic facilities: signs must attach to the fence, scoreboard or bleachers, may face in or out, and may not rise above them.
motions.impact: Sports leagues and sponsors hanging banners at fields would follow these limits once the council acts. People living near a field could see signs facing outward.

motions.item_title: Recommend approval to the City Council of 7. B. with the addition that 1-2 vehicles/RVs, not ti…
motions.motion: Commissioner Whiting moved to recommend approval to the City Council of 7. B. with the addition that 1-2 vehicles/RVs, not titled to the owner, may be parked on the property as long as it meets all other requirements. Commissioner Allen seconded the motion.
motions.headline: Allow 1 to 2 vehicles or RVs owned by others on a property
motions.summary: The commission recommended approval of Item 7B, adding that 1 to 2 vehicles or RVs not titled to the owner may be parked on the property if all other requirements are met.
motions.impact: This could matter if you park a friend's or relative's RV or car on land covered by this item. It is not in force: the City Council decides.

motions.item_title: Recommend approval to the City Council of Item 7. C. Commissioner Allen seconded the motion
motions.motion: Commissioner Hess moved to recommend approval to the City Council of Item 7. C. Commissioner Allen seconded the motion.
motions.headline: Item 7C sent to the council with support
motions.summary: The commission recommended council approval of Item 7C. The motion as recorded gives no description of the item.
motions.impact: Nothing takes effect from this vote. What Item 7C covers, and whom it reaches, is not stated in the motion.

motions.item_title: Recommend approval to the City Council of Item 7D Commissioner Hess seconded the motion
motions.motion: Commissioner Whiting moved to recommend approval to the City Council of Item 7D Commissioner Hess seconded the motion.
motions.headline: Item 7D sent to the council with support
motions.summary: The commission recommended that the City Council approve Item 7D. The motion does not name what the item was.
motions.impact: The record here is too thin to say who this touches. The council makes the final call later.

motions.item_title: Table consideration of the Transportation Master Plan/IFFP and the Public Hearing to be left op…
motions.motion: Commissioner Allen moved to table consideration of the Transportation Master Plan/IFFP and the Public Hearing to be left open until the June 24, 2025, Planning Commission meeting. Commissioner Whiting seconded the motion.
motions.headline: Transportation master plan pushed to June 24
motions.summary: The commission delayed a decision on the Transportation Master Plan and its Impact Fee Facilities Plan, and kept the public hearing open until June 24, 2025.
motions.impact: Nothing about roads or fees changed at this meeting. If you want to speak on the plan, the hearing is still open on June 24.
